issue.title: Ownership Maestro fixtures: conflict / open Peer Check seeds + claim baseline restore
issue.body:
## Summary

Follow-up from [#574](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/574) / PR #582.

Partial slice landed for mine / other / unassigned / online auto-claim. These AC items remain open and need Product/API input before they can be automated safely.

## Deferred acceptance criteria (waived on #574)

1. **Conflict fixture role** — `hasConflict=true` chapter for list + Record conflict chrome. `assign-selected` cannot set `hasConflict`.
2. **Open Peer Check fixture role** — Peer Check with no `peerChecker`. `assign-selected` cannot set `status=peer_check`.
3. **Claim baseline restore between runs** — After auto-claim, chapters stay assigned/`draft`. API cannot restore `not_started`. Suite rotates claim labels (pool drains) or requires manual Fluent web Status reset.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Documented or automated seed path for conflict chapters (or Product accepts permanent SKIPPED)
- [ ] Documented or automated seed path for open Peer Check (or Product accepts permanent SKIPPED)
- [ ] Disposable claim baseline can be restored without permanently burning the fixture project (API support or admin reset runbook)

## Links

- Parent: #574
- Audit context: #532
